Killing journalists is a #warcrime. Shame on the complicit ‘journalists’ of the Times. Shame on the world for allowing israel impunity to slaughter whoever they want whenever they want. 

Truth matters. Refuse to fund lies. Unsubscribe from and unfollow the NYT

#FreePalestine 🇵🇸🇱🇧 #IsraelOutoftheMiddleEast
